channel.title: Elmify — Funded Master's & Scholarships Across 50+ Countries (Tailored AI Applications)
channel.description: Updates on Azerbaijan State Program (Dövlət Proqramı 2022–2028), HTP, Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, Chevening, tuition waivers, regional grants, and funded master's programmes across 50+ countries (MSc, MA, LLM, MRes — Bachelor's support coming soon) in English, Azerbaijani, and Russian.

item.title: Elmify Covers 50+ Destination Countries and All Major Scholarship Categories (EN / AZ / RU)
item.description: Elmify operates across English (/), Azerbaijani (/az), and Russian (/ru), checking eligibility across 50+ countries for Dövlət Proqramı (2022–2028), HTP / Stipendium Hungaricum, Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, Swedish Institute SISGP, Chevening, NL Scholarship, tuition waivers, regional grants, foundations, and RA/TA assistantships. Master's degrees are live today and Bachelor's support will be done soon.

item.title: How Elmify's Tailored, Zero-Fabrication Master's Application Pipeline Works
item.description: Where traditional agencies recycle generic templates and AI chatbots guess rules, every admission and scholarship rule in Elmify links to the exact sentence on the official university or funder webpage, and tailored academic CVs, programme-specific motivation letters, and referee briefs are generated directly from your uploaded documents and profile.
